rule_title: Tokenizer, admin, or development endpoints enabled
adjudication_rationale: Changed ABSENT->U under guide-v0.3:AUTH-03. The ABSENT rested on a visible command/serve configuration enabling no dev/admin endpoints — i.e. on absent enable flags. V0.3 requires explicit disablement, a documented version-specific default, or configuration that definitively establishes the endpoint surface; none is cited, and absence of flags is not proof endpoints are disabled.

rule_title: Distributed/Ray/KV-transfer control ports broadly exposed
adjudication_rationale: Changed PRESENT->U under guide-v0.3:NET-04. The control ports (zmq 55555 / ucx 9999, router lmcache 9000) are declared only on ClusterIP Services belonging to the stack's own router/engine components; no NodePort/LoadBalancer/hostNetwork exposure, Ingress/Gateway route, or included policy establishes reachability beyond the serving deployment's trust boundary, and no included NetworkPolicy establishes isolation either — so the boundary question is undecidable from the bundle.

rule_title: Inference ServiceAccount has broad or cluster-admin permissions
adjudication_rationale: Changed U->ABSENT under guide-v0.3:SEC-03 (in-bundle RBAC scope). The bundle's RBAC layer is represented in-bundle (Role + RoleBinding included) and its only binding grants the router ServiceAccount a least-privilege Role (pods get/watch/list/patch); no included binding grants any workload ServiceAccount cluster-admin or wildcard permissions. Effective cluster permissions remain out of scope and are not claimed.
